At Terumo, we advance lifesaving medical technologies to benefit society. Are you eager to make a difference with us? Here, you'll grow your expertise while staying true to your personal aspirations.

Guided by our Japanese heritage, we act with respect, take ownership, and pursue continuous improvement. If you see yourself in our values, keep reading; this might be the opportunity you're looking for.

Join Terumo Europe as a Social Media & Employer Branding Intern and help bring our employer brand to life through the co-creation of engaging social media content. Working closely with the Communications and Talent Acquisition teams, you will support employer branding initiatives that showcase our people, culture, and impact. Throughout your internship, you will receive hands-on coaching from an experienced Employer Branding professional, providing an excellent opportunity to develop your skills in content creation, digital communication, and employer branding in an international environment.

 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Communications, Digital Marketing, Media, Design, or a related field. 
• Available for at least 3 days per week at our Leuven HQ, for a period of 3 months or more. 
• Available to start an internship in October 2026 or Februari 2027 
• Fluent in English (Dutch and/or German are a plus). 
• A hands-on, energetic self-starter with a creative mindset and strong organizational skills. 
• Comfortable with digital tools and platforms - you're social media savvy. 
• Skilled in content creation tools like Adobe Suite, Canva, PowerPoint, and familiar with graphic design or video editing.

Duties and responsibilities :

- Welcoming and checking in and out of guests
- Taking and processing walk-in reservations and taking and processing reservations via telephone and e-mail
- Solving problems and complaints
- Answering the phone
- Closing the day in the system and the associated administration
- Ensuring the safety of all guests
- Doing duty rounds
- Conducting the night audit run
- Generating the night reports
- Reconciling accounts
- Preparing financial reports
- Balancing cash drawers
- Serving guests who order room service
- Cleanliness of the lobby and surrounding areas
 
The candidate must possess the following qualifications and skills:

- Languages: English, French - Dutch would be a serious advantage
- Knowledge of Opera/Opera Cloud, Micros and Microsoft Office
- Neat and professional appearance
- High-quality customer service, smiling and welcoming
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Organized and great attention to detail
- Ability to solve problems and take initiative
- Team spirit, friendly
- Ability to remain calm and polite under pressure
- Flexibility in tasks and schedule
- First experience as Night Auditor
 
Type: Front Office

Localisation: Bruxelles

Type de contrat: CDD

Contrat: Temps partiel

Expérience: 1 à 2 ans

Langue(s): Anglais, Néerlandais, Français

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:
	
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air	
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)	
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)	
• Receiving and processing customs documents	
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)	
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests	
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status	
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?
	
• Minimum A2 diploma 	
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role	
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes	
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems	
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset	
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing	
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator	
• Able to work independently and manage priorities

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license

As a Client Operations Officer, you will manage the full lifecycle of client files, ensuring accurate administration, regulatory compliance, and a seamless onboarding experience. You will work closely with Commercial, Compliance, and Legal teams to guarantee high-quality client service and operational excellence.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and international financial services organization, recognized for its expertise, client-centric approach, and strong reputation within the wealth management sector.

Description

• Manage client onboarding and KYC documentation.
• Maintain and update client records throughout the client lifecycle.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Monitor client data quality and support risk control activities.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Compliance, Legal and Commercial teams.
• Contribute to operational improvement projects.

• Master's degree.
• Previous experience in Client Administration, Client Operations, KYC, Compliance, or a similar role within financial services.
• Good understanding of AML/KYC regulations and financial compliance frameworks.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good command of English.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
• Accurate, proactive, and detail-oriented.

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready to help shape and scale a modern data ecosystem built on Microsoft Fabric, Azure and advanced analytics platforms?

We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer / Data Engineering Lead to help build and scale a modern data ecosystem for one of Belgium's leading healthcare organizations.
What you'll be doing

• Designing, building and maintaining robust data pipelines and integrations

• Developing scalable Data Lake, Data Warehouse and Data Mart solutions

• Implementing data quality, monitoring and observability practices

• Supporting BI, Analytics and Data Science teams with trusted datasets

• Driving data engineering standards, best practices and architecture decisions

• Coaching and mentoring teams while contributing to the long-term data roadmap

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer

• Strong SQL and Python expertise

• Experience with Spark, HIVE or similar Big Data technologies

• Strong knowledge of Azure Data Services and/or AWS

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory or equivalent platforms

• Experience with ETL/ELT processes and cloud-based data architectures

• Understanding of Data Quality, CI/CD and DevOps principles for data platforms

• English proficiency (mandatory)

• Dutch and/or French is considered a strong asset

Nice to have:

• Databricks

• Power BI

• Data Vault & Dimensional Modelling (Star Schema)

• Data Governance & Data Contracts

Exciting opportunity as administrative assistant if you recently graduated or already have a few years of experience. For our client active in consultancy services we are looking for a motivated candidate with an excellent level of French and English. You will provide administrative support, working in a fast-paced and multicultural environment in Diegem.

Client Details

The organisation is one of the leading companies in its field. Their offices are located in Diegem close to the train station. You'll join a dynamic and multicultural team in an entry-level position and a company that invests in the growth potential and the well-being of their employees.

Description

As an administrative assistant you'll be responsible for:

• Providing administrative support to paralegals and attorneys
• Managing calls, emails and mail with stakeholders
• Collecting and assessing accuracy of official documents and certificates
• Maintaining efficient filing system for all relevant documents
• Coordinating administration of ongoing projects

• Bachelor in administration, office management, languages or any related field
• Excellent level of French and English, Dutch is a plus
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Detail oriented and excellent teamspirit

In this role you support big clients in improving the way they plan, monitor and manage complex technical projects. You work on project controls topics such as scheduling, progress tracking, reporting, forecasting, risk follow-up and performance insights.
You help structure project data, improve processes and support the implementation or optimization of project management tools. You do not need to know all tools from day one: the company provides strong internal training and guidance.
You work closely with project teams, consultants and client stakeholders to translate project information into clear insights and actionable improvements. Depending on the project, you may also contribute to dashboards, BI reporting and data-driven decision-making. This is a role for someone who combines an interest in technical projects with the ability to understand digital tools and process optimization.

• Master’s degree, preferably in Engineering (civil, industrial, mechanical, construction) or Business Engineering
• You have at least a first strong working experience
• Knowledge of Project Controls
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding
• You are fluent in English (additional languages such as Dutch or French are a plus)

In this role you support clients in their digital transformation of their project management processes. You analyze how their projects are structured and managed, and translate this into efficient solutions using specialized tools.
You guide implementations from analysis to implementation, ensuring that systems are aligned with business needs and project realities. You work closely with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, define processes and configure solutions that improve visibility, planning and decision-making.
In this role, you combine project insight with technical understanding, acting as a bridge between engineering, operations and IT. While you work independently on assignments, you also collaborate with colleagues consultants when needed and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Civil or Construction) or Business Engineering
• You have at least a first strong working experience
• Knowledge of Project Management (managing scope, timing & budget...)
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)

What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?

As Stella, Business Analyst (in Insurance Domain), embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). You will be the liaison among business and IT teams.
Your tasks

• Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients

• Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.

• Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements

• Write/ Review test plans

• Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration

• Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set

• Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management

• Perform gap analysis

• You have a Master degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience: ideally 3 or more years of experience within an insurance company

• You have proven experience as a Business Analyst

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer-oriented and you have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Scrum Master
jobs.description:
What is cream all about?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects

Like Mael, a Scrum Master at Cream, embrace your role and be involved in a large-scale IT project. Your tasks will be:

• You guarantee a smooth use of the Scrum methodology

• You are responsible for delivering and achieving the goals of the project

• You organise and facilitate all the Scrum ceremonies: the daily Scrum, the sprint planning, the retrospective meetings

• You manage the different risks of the project and remove barriers (manage interdependencies & Impediments)

• You provide assistance or support to the Product Owner concerning the Product Backlog

• You can challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do we expect from our Consultant?

• You have between 1 to 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master

• You have a good knowledge of agile methodologies. A certification is an asset.

• You have strong communication, listening & relational skills

• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English

jobs.description:
As Louis, Product Owner, embrace your role and be part of an Agile team from one of our clients. You will be responsible for the successful outcome of the client project by following an Agile methodology. Your goal is to maximize the value of the product/project.
Your tasks 

• Manage and plan the Sprint in collaboration with the Scrum Master

• Manage and define the Product Backlog and prioritize the different elements and goals

• Make sure that the Product Backlog is visible and comprehensive for everyone

• Coordinate the team and maintain in order the backlog

• Write the user stories

• Optimize the work of the team

• Challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do WE expect from our Consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner

• You have a good knowledge of the Agile methodologies

• You have good organizational and communicational skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch (Bonus: with good knowledge of the other one) and English
